source_trace.finding: The durable Board mutation completed, but the request fiber synchronously ran Keeper routing/wake and SSE/activity projection before returning the receipt.

repair.head: 2bc6849b58ccbc4c2f7fdd1e388545c62fc53be1
repair.scope: Defer registered initialized Keeper lanes for Discoverable posts to their durable owner cursors; retain producer-side durable candidates for registered zero-cursor lanes; keep addressed delivery unchanged.
repair.known_limit: A Discoverable post created before a bootable Keeper has registered any lane still has no producer-side lane to record. That pre-registration startup window predates this repair and remains a separate lifecycle requirement.

interpretation.verified: The unique post was durably visible after the delayed 201 response and was removed by exact-id cleanup.
interpretation.not_verified: Comment, vote, reaction, reload durability, karma UI, and screenshots were not reached.
interpretation.timeout_policy: The 20 second browser timeout was retained as a detector; it was not raised to hide the latency defect.
